name: Old Wanchai Market Building
scope: The surviving 1937 Old Wan Chai Market entrance, curved façade and street wings within the current One Wanchai development. The attached residential tower is included as surveyed context.
era: Current preserved exterior within the completed One Wanchai redevelopment.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla original shows the market entrance in 2007 before conversion. Used for the curved wall, shadowed ribbons, white concrete and dark-edge canopies retained in situ. The original author and uploader are the same linked account.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with Chong Fat’s exact public-domain file published in Qualla. The government preservation text and Lands Department plan records establish the contemporary transition from the historic frontage to the tall building.
